title: William F. Cahoon
vital_facts: Mission to Ohio, Pennsylvania, and New York 1832-1833
Ordained Seventy and called to First Quorum of Seventy 1835
Married Nancy Marinda Gibbs 1836; twelve children; later practiced plural marriage
Trekked west with saints arriving in 1849
Died 1883, 1893, or 1897; Salt Lake City, Utah
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
